Package org.zvec.binding

Class Collection

java.lang.Object
org.zvec.binding.Collection
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Collection extends Object implements AutoCloseable
High-level wrapper for zvec_collection_t.

Obtain via Zvec.createAndOpen(java.lang.String, org.zvec.binding.CollectionSchema, org.zvec.binding.CollectionOptions) or Zvec.open(java.lang.String, org.zvec.binding.CollectionOptions). Always call close() when done.

After close() every operation on this object throws a ZvecException with ErrorCode.FAILED_PRECONDITION instead of passing a released handle into the native layer.

close() and destroy() are safe to call from any thread and are idempotent. The operations themselves are not synchronized: the native collection is safe to use from several threads, but a caller must not use a collection concurrently with closing it.

    • createIterator

      public DocIterator createIterator(IteratorOptions options)
      Create a snapshot document iterator over this collection.

      The iterator sees an isolated snapshot taken at call time. While any iterator is open, schema changes (create/drop index, add/alter/drop column) and destroy() return an error; close every iterator before releasing the last collection handle.

      Parameters:
      options - iterator options, or null for defaults (all fields, vectors included)
